text: If you've got outdoor plans for the rest of today, keep half an eye on the sky rather than writing it off. It's mostly cloudy and mild out there right now, mid 70s, and that holds as the ceiling for the afternoon as a couple of upper-level troughs slide through. The official call is scattered showers, 50-50 odds, but the models are split hard on how wet it actually gets, the American model wants almost nothing while the European is soaking it in, so I'd lean toward more scattered than steady, quick hits rather than a washout. The lake's calm, winds light and dropping to nothing, waves a foot or two, water still a comfortable 72. Showers taper off this evening before wrapping up around 1am, and fog moves in overnight. Air's clean, nothing to worry about there. Bottom line: keep a rain jacket handy through this evening, but don't scrap outdoor plans, and expect a genuinely nicer, sunnier Wednesday with highs near 80 waiting on the other side.
